Subject: Security exhibit — proposed rolling evidence cadence & pen-test language (HealthBridge)

Team / HealthBridge,

Attaching a focused redline for the Security Exhibit and a short set of asks so we can converge quickly on the MSA + Order Form redlines. High-level summary of what we want to lock in: 

- Pen test window language: mutual notice + limited scope; we prefer staging/ephemeral environment access and not ongoing privileged production access.
- Audit rights: reasonable inspection windows (30 days notice), scoped requests, and a secure mechanism for evidence transfer (S3 link + signed NDA *for that evidence*) or ephemeral console jumpbox.
- SOC 2 evidence cadence: we can provide annual SOC 2 report + quarterly SOC summary (control changes, exceptions), plus rolling 90-day log export for audit sampling.
- Data retention & redaction: confirm redaction process for PII in evidence exports and the retention band for logs we will provide.
- Incident response / forensics: commitment to provide timelines and redacted artifacts upon a verified legal request; full forensic images will be scoped with legal.

Attachment: HealthBridge_SecurityExhibit_Redline_v2.pdf (pdf) — redline highlights the compromise language we've used with other mid-market customers.

Next step: can we get their procurement team to mark up the redline and identify absolute blockers? I propose a short call Mon 4/5 to run through the differences (20m).

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the redline. We've reviewed internally and have two initial asks before we schedule a call:

1) Scope of penetration test: our security team is comfortable limiting the pen test to (a) infrastructure and (b) Redwood-managed app layers. We are uncomfortable with any language that could permit unfettered production testing without stricter controls. Can Redwood confirm whether the pen test will be performed against a staging environment and what artifact-level access will be required?

2) SOC2 evidence: the Order Form currently requests "SOC2 evidence as requested." We need a clearer cadence and artifacts list. Specifically: full SOC 2 attestation (annual) + evidence snapshots for key controls (change mgmt, access control, logging) on a quarterly basis. Will Redwood provide an executive controls summary for each quarter?

I've attached our procurement team's annotated feedback: HealthBridge_orderform_feedback.pdf (pdf). We propose a call Mon 4/5 at 10am PT — would that work for Redwood ops + legal?

Regards,

Thanks Maria / Irene — quick legal take and proposed middle-ground language: 

- Pen test: we can accept language that the penetration test is limited to non-production (staging) or segregated test harnesses representing production. We will require a 14-30 day notice and a signed statement of scope. We cannot (and will not) allow open production testing or persistent credentials. Suggested clause: "Customer may conduct a single annual penetration test against Redwood-managed staging environments with 30 days prior written notice; access will be provisioned via ephemeral administrative credentials and limited to agreed IP ranges and target lists. Redwood will coordinate and may require a certified third-party tester agreement."

- Audit rights: propose 30-day notice, evidence delivery via secure link (S3 pre-signed or a secure file share), and PII redaction for any artifacts. For SOC2 cadence: we will provide the annual SOC2 report and a quarterly controls summary (1–2 page executive summary) that lists any control changes or open exceptions. For ad hoc evidence requests, we propose a small set of pre-authorized artifacts the customer can request once per quarter without additional legal review.

I've added redline language in the attached: Redwood_proposed_exhibit_v3.docx (docx). Laura — can you confirm whether this aligns with our current MSA template? Marcus — can ops confirm we can deliver the quarterly summary + 90-day rolling log export on request (redacted)?

-Karthik
Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

+1 on Karthik's wording, and operational notes from the infra side: 

- Pen test: we can support a staging-only test harness with ephemeral creds and agreed IP ranges. We will not provision persistent production admin accounts. For tests that require deeper system-level access we'll require a signed statement of work and a coordinated maintenance window.

- SOC2 cadence & evidence: current ops plan can deliver:
  * Annual SOC 2 report (full attest)
  * Quarterly 1–2 page executive control summary (automated snapshot)
  * Rolling 90-day log export for scope-limited audit requests (we will redact PII from exported artifacts; export generation ~2–3 business days)

- Evidence transfer mechanics: secure S3 pre-signed link (encrypted at rest) + per-transfer NDA for any sensitive artifact, or an ephemeral secure file share. We'll validate the HealthBridge list of pre-authorized artifacts to avoid legal back-and-forth on each request.

Attachment: ops-evidence-matrix.csv (csv) — maps control families to available artifacts and estimated delivery times.

Marcus Lin
